LanguageData.CC_Dip_Sub: What is owed each way, and the colony's ties with each people within reach.
LanguageData.CC_Dip_Off: Favors owed and called in are switched off in the settings: no new debt is made or called in, and those open run out by their terms.
LanguageData.CC_Dip_OwedUs_None: Nobody owes the colony a debt of honor now. A good turn big enough in a people's memory leaves one: one of theirs freed or tended, refugees taken in, a lost child found, a town rebuilt.
LanguageData.CC_Dip_OwedByUs_None: The colony owes nobody now. Help it takes from a people (their fighters, relief, medicine, lessons) leaves a debt they may call in when they are in need.
LanguageData.CC_Dip_NoPeoples: No people has a town within the region map's reach, and none has a tie with the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Dip_NoTies: No ties with the colony yet.

LanguageData.CC_SetNote_DiplomacyFavours: Debts of honor either way: the colony calls in what it is owed, and the peoples what it owes them.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DiplomacyFavours_Tip: A good turn of size 10 or more in a people's memory leaves a debt of honor: they owe the colony for one of theirs freed or tended, refugees taken in, a lost child found, a town rebuilt; the colony owes them for their fighters, relief, medicine or lessons. One each way per people and colony, renewed by a new good turn, let go two years after if nobody asks; a notable helped in person owes the colonist who did it (twelve such at most). The colony calls one in by letter, by call, from the region window's Peoples or face to face: a load of goods (about 400 silver's worth by their town's fortune), a word with a third people (10 goodwill), a colonist of the colony they hold, or their help toward peace with a people at war with the colony. They honor it while their head thinks well of the colony (regard 20 or more), seven times in ten below that, four in ten below 0; a refusal is remembered. They call in what the colony owes them about once in 90 days, only with a need the world shows (medicine in a sickness, food in a famine, hands at harvest, their homeless taken in, the colony's word in a feud), at most once a season; refused or left unanswered, the debt breaks and they lose 5 goodwill toward the colony. Off: no debt is made or called in, and those open run out by their terms.
